## Goal
Update preplanning SKILL.md Phase H to dispatch spec-fidelity-check.sh before story finalization. Fidelity failure escalates to user with diff view; finalization does not auto-retry.

## Files to Modify
- plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md: in Phase H (story creation), before marking each story final, call spec-fidelity-check.sh; on exit 1 -> halt with FIDELITY_FAIL: show diff to user (field, pil_text, dd_text); do NOT auto-retry or auto-correct

## Acceptance Criteria
- grep -c 'spec-fidelity-check' plugins/dso/skills/preplanning/SKILL.md should be at least 1
- bash tests/scripts/test-spec-fidelity-check.sh exits 0 (still GREEN)

## Testing Mode
GREEN (instruction file update; depends S9/T2)
